---
name: UX Improvement / 交互或界面改进
about: Report a pain point in existing UI or interaction flow. / 反馈现有界面或操作流程中的体验痛点。
title: "[UX] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Where / 哪个位置

哪个页面、哪个操作让你觉得不舒服？

Which page or interaction feels off?

## Pain Point / 痛点

当前哪里不好？是难找、难操作、看不清、还是流程太绕？

What exactly is the problem? Hard to find? Hard to operate? Hard to see? Too many steps?

## Expected Experience / 期望体验

你希望的体验是什么样的？

How should it feel instead?

## Environment / 环境信息

- Device / 设备: Desktop / Tablet / Mobile
- Browser / 浏览器:

## Screenshots or Sketches / 截图或草图

手绘草图也可以，画出你期望的布局或交互流程即可。

Hand-drawn sketches are welcome — just show the layout or interaction flow you have in mind.
